notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
Sattelite now has controller support. The controls have been simplified for those not using auto-clickers as well as for those that use auto-clickers. This update also ads time-based and rng drops to the game.

[list]
[*] 1 common card drop per 60min
[*] 50% chance of uncommon card
[*] 20% chance of rare card
[/list]
